Septimus Consulting

An identity built on trust.

The story

Roman references meet a clear, confident visual language for an overseas training and consulting agency.

Client
Septimus Consulting
Focus
Branding

The name Septimus led the identity towards Roman patterns and a face with classical features. The aim was to connect that heritage with the confidence people look for in a training and consulting partner.

A black-and-white palette, clean logo lines and bold typography bring the system together. Each element supports a straightforward, formal expression of the brand.
